en.subtitle: Senior Backend Engineer — Go · Ruby · Python, Cloud & Distributed Systems

about.paragraph1: I build and run backend systems: Go, Ruby, and Python services and the APIs, auth, data models, and cloud infrastructure behind them. 15+ years of production software in logistics, fintech, medical IT, and games. In Tokyo since 2004.
about.paragraph2: At Veltra I work on Python, Go, and Node services on AWS ECS with Terraform, including an activity-search MCP connector listed in Anthropic's public Claude connector directory. Before that I owned core domain areas and the shared integration-test harness of a Go logistics SaaS. I care about correctness under concurrency, idempotency, and tests that let a team change production code safely.
